column1: # RDev framing fixtures. Byte semantics: docs/protocol-framing.md.
# Hex is lowercase, no separators. Byte order is network order.
#   Rows sharing a file decode in order; remainingHex is what is left after the last row of that file.
#   offseted=1: offset is a signed decimal int64; payloadHex is the bytes after the offset word.
